svg.title: Deal4Me system architecture
svg.desc: Animated architecture diagram of Deal4Me, read left to right in four columns. Clients: a seller app at /seller/* (Listings, Scan, Messages, Profile) and a buyer app at /visit/* (Home, Chat, Messages, Profile) shown as phones, plus the web pages /sell/start onboarding (voice, photos, website), /sell/studio, the public storefront /s/[slug] and /sell/dashboard. A Zustand store mirrored to localStorage refreshes from the server on focus and every 15 seconds; messages poll every 3 seconds. Every client calls one set of Next.js API routes: /api/ai/* (transcribe, describe, search, appraise, appraise/comps, suggest-price, damage-check, storefront-instruction, restyle), /api/deals/negotiations (auto, which streams NDJSON, and [id]/messages), and /api/data/* (shops, publish, items, orders, order status, state, requests, chats, messages, rentals hold, pickup, return and settle). Routes call three server modules: src/server/ai, where transcribe.ts calls a local Whisper large-v3-turbo server on mlx-audio at 127.0.0.1:8765 and every model call goes through askClaude; src/server/deals, where an owner agent and a buyer agent negotiate through the hard limits in rules.ts and also call askClaude; and src/server/data, the catalog store, conversations and rentals ledger. askClaude runs headless Claude Code sessions through the Claude Agent SDK: Sonnet for photo vision, describe, restyle, storefront edits and damage checks; Haiku for search, pricing and both negotiation agents. State is JSON files in .data/ (catalog.json, conversations.json, negotiations.json, ai-cache/), movable with RIDGE_DATA_DIR. A loop of about 14 seconds then plays three flows, lighting the active path in crimson with a caption: 1, a seller's voice clip goes from onboarding to /api/ai/transcribe and Whisper and comes back as text, goes to /api/ai/describe where Claude Sonnet drafts the storefront, and is saved through /api/data/shops into catalog.json; 2, a buyer's query in any language goes to /api/ai/search, Claude Haiku only parses it, code filters catalog.json and the results return; 3, a negotiate request goes to /api/deals/negotiations/auto, the two Haiku agents trade offers through the rules.ts gate, the deal is saved to negotiations.json and rounds stream back to the buyer. With reduced motion the full diagram is shown without movement.

g.text: One Next.js 16 server. Every model call is a headless Claude Code session; speech-to-text and data stay on this machine.
refresh on focus and every 15 s
GET lists, POST starts a manual deal
Every model call goes through askClaude. A failed call returns 502 or 503 and never falls back to canned data.
Whisper turns the voice clip into text on this machine, Sonnet drafts the storefront, and the seller saves it to catalog.json.
Haiku only parses the request into a filter. Code picks published shops from catalog.json and checks prices and dates live.
Each agent turn is a Haiku call. rules.ts checks every offer against the floor, and rounds stream back to the buyer as NDJSON.
